desc:
Welcome to the night shift at the Kitty Toy Store. You’ve just started your new job surrounded by cheerful shelves and familiar childhood faces. The lights are warm, the music plays softly. Everything feels perfectly normal  maybe even a little boring. It’s just another quiet night among toys and memories... or so you think. What could possibly go wrong?
